test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The difference between the external and internal curved surface areas of a 7 cm long cylindrical metallic pipe is 110 cm² . If the pipe is made of 302.5 cm³ metal, then find the inner radius of the pipe.

(Use π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
Given:

The difference between the external and internal curved surface areas of a 7 cm long cylindrical metallic pipe is 110 cm2 .

The pipe is made of 302.5 cm3 metal

Concept used:

In the case of a cylindrical pipe, volume = π × (R²₁ - R²₂) × H

Here R₁ and R₂ are the external and internal radius of the pipe and H = Height of the pipe

Curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πRH

Here R = Radius of the base and H = Height

A2 - B2 = (A + B) (A - B)

Calculation:

Let the outer and inner radius of the pipe be R and r centimeter respectively.

According to the question,

2πR × 7 - 2πr × 7 = 110

⇒ 2 × (22)/(7) × 7 × (R - r) = 110

⇒ 44(R - r) = 110

⇒ (R - r) = 110/44

⇒ (R - r) = 2.5 ....(1)

According to the question,

π × (R² - r²) × 7 = 302.5

⇒ (22)/(7) × 7 × (R² - r²) = 302.5

⇒ (R2 - r2) = 302.5/22

⇒ (R2 - r2) = 13.75

⇒ (R + r) (R - r) = 13.75

⇒ (R + r) × 2.5 = 13.75 (From 1)

⇒ (R + r) = 13.75/2.5

⇒ (R + r) = 5.5 ....(2)

Solving (1) and (2),

R = 4 and r = 1.5

∴ The inner radius of the pipe is 1.5 cm.
